basic_info.description: Perched atop the vibrant Divisadero corridor, 223 Divisadero is a beautiful Victorian built at the turn of the century. Behind the pretty faade with ornate details are soaring ceilings, intricate woodwork, and Douglas fir floors throughout. The formal living room is framed by a bay window, moldings, and a wood-burning fireplace, open to an elegant formal dining room. A skylight brightens the center hall, leading to a stylishly renovated kitchen with quartz counters, sleek tile backsplash, deluxe appliances, and the home's original brick hearth. Off the kitchen are enclosed stairs down to the garage, as well as a ladder leading to over 400 sq. ft. of (bonus) attic with tall ceilings and windows/skylights! The front bedroom boasts a fireplace and oversized windows, and the ensuite bath is outfitted with a glass-enclosed shower. A middle bedroom offers dual closets, and the generous rear primary suite includes 2 walk-in closets, an attractive bath with shower over tub, and direct access to the lovely, landscaped backyard. The 4-car garage houses laundry and storage, with expansion potential in both the garage and attic. Located just 2 blocks from Buena Vista Park and a short stroll to Duboce Park, Golden Gate Park, Alamo Park, cafes, and wine bars on Divisadero and Haight St.
